citations.claim: at first violating step body 3 moves at extreme squeeze-ejection speed
one step before, body 3 was on the right side of wall 0 approaching it

counterfactual.change: reduced heavy impactor body 0 vx from -60 to -5; squeeze ejection no longer occurs and no tunneling in same 22 steps

explanation: A heavy fast impactor slams a dense cluster of light bodies against/near a thin wall. Iterative impulse + positional correction injects huge energy into squeezed light bodies (speeds >300 from 60 initial). The ejected body 3 then moves so far per substep that discrete collision handling misses the wall, so its centre passes through wall 0 between steps 21 and 22.

violation.detail: body centre moved through wall 0 between steps 21 and 22

vision_note: In step 21 the small red body is just to the right of the bottom of the tall left wall, then in step 22 it appears on the left/outside of that same wall. It jumps straight through the wall between consecutive steps with no intermediate contact.
